# IRIS AUH5 Data Centre

> This campus serves cloud, enterprise and artificial intelligence workloads, and its newer halls are built for the far higher rack densities that AI and high-performance computing demand. It sits within one of the fastest-growing concentrations of digital infrastructure in the area. A hyperscale data centre campus made up of several linked facilities of roughly 6 MW each and about 36 MW of IT capacity in total. The Tier III-certified campus offers some 8,200 square metres of white space, carrier-neutral connectivity and diverse fibre entry to support enterprise workloads.

## Project Overview

- Category: Advanced Technical Facilities
- Location: KEZAD, Abu Dhabi, UAE

## MENASCO Scope

This project introduces liquid cooling for Sky 21 at IRIS (AUH 5.4), part of Khazna Data Centers' KDC-AUH5 campus in the Khalifa Industrial Zone Abu Dhabi. Liquid cooling enables the higher rack densities required by AI and high-performance computing workloads. MENASCO's scope covers the liquid cooling works, extending its role on Khazna's IRIS campus alongside its earlier retrofit works. IRIS, also known as KDC-AUH5, is Khazna Data Centers' hyperscale campus in the Khalifa Industrial Zone Abu Dhabi (KIZAD), comprising several data centres of around 6 MW each. Undertaken as additional works for Khazna, MENASCO's scope covers MEP retrofit works on the campus's existing facilities, helping to keep mission-critical infrastructure performing reliably.
